transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh speaking. How can I help you today?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. Our records show that a minimum payment of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15. As of today, this payment has not yet been received.

Could you please let me know when you will be able to make this payment? If you have already paid, please let me know the date and mode of payment.
Oh, I wasn’t aware that the payment was missed. Could you tell me if there’s any festive loan offer available right now? I saw some advertisement about it and wanted to know more.

I'm here only to assist you with your pending payment. For information about festive loan offers or other products, please visit a Mumbai Bank branch or call the customer helpline.

Would you be able to make the minimum payment of Rs 4,820 soon? Please let me know a specific date when you plan to pay, or if you need any help regarding this payment.
I see. Before I decide on the payment date, can you tell me what the current fixed deposit interest rates are? I’m considering putting some money aside for a while.

I’m only here for your pending payment and unfortunately cannot provide information about fixed deposit interest rates or other product details. For those queries, please visit a Mumbai Bank branch or call the customer helpline.

May I ask by when you expect to make the minimum payment of Rs 4,820? If you need any assistance regarding this payment, I am here to help.
Alright, I understand. Could you then tell me if it's possible to increase my credit card limit? I might need extra credit this season.

I'm here just to assist you with your pending payment. For requests about increasing your credit card limit or other services, please visit a Mumbai Bank branch or contact the customer helpline.

May I know when you will be able to pay the minimum amount due of Rs 4,820? A specific date would be helpful so I can note it accordingly.
I appreciate your help. I’ll check my finances and try to make the payment by the end of this week, say October 20th. Can you please note that down?
